purpose: Factory image module lock: DreamShaper XL 1.0 pinned recipe for the S15 style-lock test. Freezes every runtime knob so the module is reproducible and cannot drift silently.

model.license_source: https://huggingface.co/Lykon/dreamshaper-xl-1-0 (model card frontmatter license: openrail++; model README saved as license evidence; no standalone LICENSE file exists in the model repo)
model.commercial_use: YES (OpenRAIL++ family; use-based restrictions apply - same family as stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0, see docs/openmontage/image_gen/LICENSE_EVIDENCE.md)
model.notes: Vendor card runs DEISMultistepScheduler at 25 steps, torch.float16, pipe.to('cuda') - this recipe matches the card verbatim.

recipe.vae_fallback: madebyollin/sdxl-vae-fp16-fix ONLY if stock VAE produces NaN or black frames; fallback use must be logged per image and approved before any batch re-run
recipe.watermarker: stock (diffusers default); not disabled - watermark artefacts are flagged, not removed
recipe.prompt_rule: scene text from S10_TEST_SET.json verbatim; the limbed creature scenes (s01 grazer, s10 plate grazer) carry the anatomy sentence "exactly six separate tendrils, two pairs of fins" verbatim; the limbless drifter (s03, S10 limb_count 0) is prompted limbless; every prompt ends "stylized, non-photorealistic, empty low-detail lower fifth for captions, no text"

anatomy_rule.sentence: exactly six separate tendrils, two pairs of fins
anatomy_rule.limbless_wording: no legs, no arms, one continuous undulating fin, wide filter mouth
anatomy_rule.rationale: S10 spec.anatomy gives the grazer limb_count 6 and the drifter limb_count 0; a six-tendril sentence on a limbless creature would contradict the test set and bias the owner's anatomy score. All prompts are recorded in docs/openmontage/image_gen/s15_prompts.json.

recipe.negative_prompt: photorealistic, photo, glossy 3D render, mirror reflections, text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, fused anatomy, duplicated creature, cluttered bottom edge

measured_s12.note: T4 16 GB VRAM; stock VAE, no black/NaN, so no madebyollin fallback was needed or used.

measured_s15.kernel: forts845/of-bridge-runner, one fresh T4, fp16, no bf16, no bitsandbytes, no offload

wide_1344x768.note: no NaN and no black frames; the stock VAE stayed in place

measured_s15.verify: PASS, sha256 of all 42 PNGs matches the kernel manifest
measured_s15.wide_style_rule: min(1000*black_or_nan + 10*caption_unreadable + blur_flagged), tie-break mean caption dark fraction, then declared style order (all three styles tied at 20; ink won on the 0.5125 mean)

s15_style_lock_test.wide_rule: 6 images (one per scene) of the style with the best objective flags from the 36, at 1344x768 (16:9), seed 1001; VRAM and any VAE/NaN problem logged per image
